title: Joshua 23
paragraphs: ¹ A long time passed, and the LORD had given Israel rest from all their surrounding enemies. Joshua had grown old and was advanced in years. ² He summoned all Israel — their elders, leaders, judges, and officials — and said to them, "I am now old and well along in years. ³ You yourselves have seen everything the LORD your God has done to all these nations on your behalf. It was the LORD your God who fought for you. ⁴ I have assigned to your tribes as an inheritance all the territory of the remaining nations — and all the nations I have already destroyed — from the Jordan to the Mediterranean Sea in the west. ⁵ The LORD your God will push them back before you and drive them from your land. You will take possession of their land, just as the LORD your God promised you.

⁶ Be very strong and courageous to obey everything written in the Book of the Law of Moses. Do not deviate from it to the right or to the left. ⁷ Do not associate with these remaining nations. Do not invoke the names of their gods, take oaths by them, serve them, or bow down to them. ⁸ Instead, hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day. ⁹ The LORD has driven out great and powerful nations before you, and to this day no one has been able to stand against you. ¹⁰ One of you can chase a thousand, because the LORD your God fights for you, just as he promised.

¹¹ So be very careful to love the LORD your God. ¹² But if you turn away and ally yourselves with the survivors of these nations that remain among you — if you intermarry with them and associate with them — ¹³ then know for certain that the LORD your God will no longer drive out these nations before you. Instead, they will become traps and snares for you, whips on your backs and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land the LORD your God has given you. ¹⁴ I am about to go the way of all the earth. You know with all your heart and soul that not one of all the good promises the LORD your God gave you has failed — every one has been fulfilled; not one has remained unfulfilled. ¹⁵ But just as all the good things the LORD your God promised you have come true, so he will also bring on you every disaster he threatened, until he has destroyed you from this good land he has given you.

¹⁶ When you violate the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and go after other gods and worship them, the LORD's anger will burn against you and you will quickly vanish from this good land he has given you."
